title: Solution Building Block (v1.1.0)
description: A concrete realisation of one or more ABBs using specific products/services (TOGAF). Realised at runtime by one or more Services. May be a composite assembled from sub-SBBs (UML composite structure: parts + ports + connectors).

endpointRef.description: A connector endpoint. Either a boundary port name ('api-gateway') or a part-scoped point in dotted form ('order-handler.input'). The validator script checks every endpoint resolves to a declared port or a declared part.

composite.description: True when this SBB is an assembly of sub-SBBs described as a UML composite structure. When true, 'parts' and 'connectors' are required.

ports.description: Interaction points on the composite boundary (UML ports). A provided port offers a contract to the environment; a required port consumes one. The technology-agnostic contract lives on the parent ABB Interface; the port names the concrete protocol/contract.

name.description: Kebab-case port name, unique within the SBB.

direction.description: 'provided' = ball (lollipop) interface offered; 'required' = socket interface consumed.

contract.description: Contract identifier or media type, e.g. 'openapi/v3', 'cloudevents/v1', or an AP-NNN api id.

abb_interface.description: ID of the parent ABB Interface this port realises, e.g. 'I1'. Establishes port -> ABB service-contract traceability.

parts.description: Typed roles inside the composite (UML parts). Each part is normally played by a sub-SBB, making this SBB a composite-of-composites.

name.description: Kebab-case role name (the part's role within this composite), unique within the SBB. UML role-name, not the type name.

sbb.description: The sub-SBB that plays this role (SB-NNN). Present for composite-of-composite parts.

role.description: What this part does within the composite.

ports.description: Optional declaration of the part's own interaction points, referenced by connectors as 'part-name.port-name'.

connectors.description: Links wiring ports and parts (UML connectors). A 'delegation' connector forwards a boundary port to a part's matching port; an 'assembly' connector wires one part's required interface to another part's provided interface.

type.description: 'delegation' = boundary port <-> internal part port; 'assembly' = part-to-part (required socket meets provided ball).

allOf.$comment: Composite SBBs MUST declare their internal structure: at least one part and at least one connector. Endpoint-resolution (every connector endpoint maps to a declared port or part, and delegation endpoints pair a boundary port with a part port) is enforced by the validator script, not expressible in pure JSON Schema.
